Home/Primary Maths Games & Pupil Reports for Schools
For schools and teachers

Primary maths practice with evidence you can use.

Use KickMaths for focused extra practice in Years 1–6. Choose a curriculum skill, review a pupil’s independent answers and use their report to decide which idea to revisit.

Explore the gameAsk about school access

Use it for a specific teaching purpose.

Targeted practice

Choose a table, written calculation or curriculum skill to reinforce an idea taught in class. Coach can revisit supporting skills when needed.

Individual pupil reports

Inspect the year-based learning chart, example questions, supported answers and each skill’s secure checklist.

A readable option for pupils

Clearly labelled dyslexia-friendly mode and a separate reduced-motion preference support different reading and visual preferences.

Check the curriculum before assigning practice.

The published Year 1–6 map follows England’s National Curriculum. Browse the year and topic lists to select suitable activities, including earlier foundations when a pupil needs them. Schools following other UK curricula can select relevant skills rather than rely on a matching year label.

View curriculum coverage

How reports work in a classroom.

Give each pupil a separate nickname profile on the device they use. Open Parent report in the grown-up area to review their work. Reports are stored locally in that browser; a backup can be transferred for review on another device. The current version does not include a cloud teacher dashboard or automatic class synchronisation.

Free beta access for schools.

Schools can try KickMaths for free during beta. Create a separate nickname profile for each pupil on the browser they use. A paid version is coming soon; pricing and launch details will be announced later.
